_readme: S639 harvest side session, 2026-11-12. Berkeley City College, third read. The second (berkeley_city_ge_pages, run 43138963119) listed one tab list under each section: 41810 under Degree and Certificate Requirements (40739, two tabs) and 41800 under Transfer Information (40736, nine tabs). Each section's own page prints only an introduction; Transfer Information says 'general education and elective courses for a total of 60 transferable units'. This read lists each tab list's tabs and opens each tab list as an entry (cq_view, the tabs joined as the capture joins a program's), so the Cal-GETC tab and the local GE pattern tab print whole. No model call.

questions.ge_units: What do Berkeley City's tabs print for Cal-GETC and for the local A.A./A.S. general education pattern: areas, each area's units, a total, and any minimum-60, electives or double-count sentence?
